Jensen Huang’s affair is just a trigger. What we are witnessing is a pre-planned power grab over Nvidia’s trillion-dollar computing empire, coordinated by Wall Street and Washington.

Some sharp Chinese-American commentators call it America’s new Red Scare targeting elite Asian entrepreneurs.

Bill Gates, Elon Musk and other white tech billionaires have faced repeated scandals over personal conduct. None were dragged into national security probes or boardroom takeovers. Only Jensen Huang, after a personal relationship misstep, faces an independent board investigation and hostile narrative from intelligence circles.

The double standard could not be clearer: For white elites, personal flaws are private matters. For a Chinese-born leader controlling a strategic tech asset, any tiny blemish gets framed as a national security risk.

Nvidia is the backbone of global AI computing, valued at roughly $4 trillion. Unlike Meta, where Mark Zuckerberg locks control with dual-class super-voting shares, or Microsoft and Amazon, deeply integrated with the Pentagon and intelligence agencies, Nvidia has no such protective structure. 

Public filings from 2026 show Jensen Huang holds only 3.58% of shares, and all directors plus executives together hold merely 3.94%. Vanguard and BlackRock own 9.32% and 7.43% respectively, holding decisive voting power. Without institutional shields or deep political backing, this critical tech giant sits exposed on the chessboard of great-power competition.

The groundwork for this takeover was laid months ago. Longtime board allies of Huang, Mark Perry and Michael McCaffrey, stepped down from key committees. Insiders tied to Democratic establishment, Wall Street and U.S. intelligence quietly moved in: 
✅ Suzanne Nora Johnson, former Goldman Sachs vice chair and co-chair of Brookings Institution, joined Nvidia’s audit committee in July 2026 with direct oversight of internal investigations and compliance. ✅ Kenneth Jacobs, vice chair of Brookings and incoming Vanguard chair, controls the largest institutional voting bloc and operates within the same inner circle as Johnson. 
✅ Gilman Louie,founding CEO of CIA-backed venture fund In-Q-Tel and member of the President’s Intelligence Advisory Board, works alongside Johnson on the same national tech fund, overseeing intelligence acquisition of strategic tech firms.

The media rollout followed a precise political timeline. Initial trial balloons appeared on Oct 29. On Nov 6, the very day Democrats secured full control of Congress, Julian Barnes of the New York Times (national security beat) and Demetri Sevastopulo of the Financial Times published coordinated reports, citing intelligence memos while breaking the story of the personal scandal.

The real offense was never the affair. It was the 2025 deal Jensen struck with the Trump administration: offering a 25% revenue share to win export approval for H200 chips into China. A normal commercial negotiation, reframed by incoming Democrats as a dangerous compromise on U.S. AI sovereignty.

This investigation will not crash Nvidia’s stock — Wall Street holds massive stakes here. But it will deliver three strategic wins for the U.S. establishment:

1. De-founder and de-Sinicize Nvidia: A new permanent national security compliance committee, led by Johnson’s faction, will strip Huang of authority over chip exports and overseas strategy. His dual Chairman-CEO role will be split.

2. Lock down China’s AI ceiling: Washington will seize full command of global advanced computing supply, regulating chip flows to slow China’s AI progress.

3. Retroactively target Trump: Once Democrats take over congressional oversight panels in January 2027, this case will be used to accuse the Trump White House of negligence for approving the H200 export deal.

Jensen Huang spent 27 years building this computing empire, believing in rules, technical merit and business contracts. But there is a brutal truth in America’s power game: Top-tier strategic technology and wealth without political cover are nothing more than bargaining chips waiting to be carved up.

White elites get generous room for error. Asian pioneers who climb to the very top get almost none. This is not a story about infidelity. It is a raw demonstration of racial hierarchy, capital control and partisan power politics in the United States.

⚠️ ALERT: $2.23 MILLION drained from Arcus DEX after accounting bug allows exploiter to inflate account balance

Arcus DEX suffered a $2.23 million exploit on November 9 after an accounting bug allowed a newly created account to record a balance far larger than its actual holdings and withdraw funds it never owned.

The exploiter also attempted to withdraw another $3 million, but the bridge's on-chain rate limit blocked the payouts before they were processed.

Arcus detected and fixed the vulnerability within roughly 90 minutes, blocked the exploiter's addresses and temporarily paused withdrawals.

The company has since covered the entire $2.23 million shortfall from its treasury, stating that no other user balances, positions or orders were affected.

The stolen funds are being tracked on-chain, with Arcus coordinating with blockchain investigators and law enforcement to pursue recovery.

一台英伟达 B300，国内灰色渠道报价已经炒到 2000 万元。

过去一年，B300 的价格经历了怎样的变化？

2025 年底：约 400 万元/台
2026 年 4 月：约 700 万元
2026 年 6 月：900 万–1000 万元
2026 年 8 月：约 1400 万元
2026 年 10 月：突破 1700 万元
2026 年 11 月：公开渠道报价达到 1700 万–2000 万元，部分戴尔 4T 版本报价 1990 万元。

以上均为 8 卡 B300 整机价格，不是单颗 GPU 的价格。不同时间点的数据来自公开报道及渠道报价，并非连续成交记录。

更夸张的是中美价差。

据路透社 4 月 30 日报道，一台搭载 8 张 B300 的服务器，在美国市场售价约 55 万美元，按当时汇率折合约 376 万元人民币。

而如今中国非官方渠道报价已经达到 1700 万–2000 万元，相当于美国参考价格的约 4.5–5.3 倍。

当然，这不是严格的同日成交价对比，但足以反映国内算力市场的稀缺溢价。

问题在于，B300 的价格上涨并不完全意味着算力本身更值钱。

出口管制、供应链风险、跨境交付成本，以及国内 AI 企业对高端算力的迫切需求，都在推高这部分溢价。

当一台 8 卡服务器的报价接近 2000 万元，算力租赁商还能否覆盖硬件成本？这场 AI 算力军备竞赛，最终又有多少利润能真正留在硬件持有者手里？

text:
Mercor announced a $750M round this week at a $20B valuation. Its CEO, Brendan Foody, is 23.

The company finds lawyers, doctors and finance professionals for AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic. They write training material, set tests for AI models and grade the results.

Mercor began as a recruiting company. Foody started it in 2023, at 19, with two high school debate teammates, matching freelance engineers in India with U.S. companies.

Later they hired more than 1,000 engineers for a data-labeling company, which placed them on AI lab projects. Foody says engineers began telling Mercor they hadn't been paid on time, and the support requests piled up.

He stopped going through the partner and started working with AI labs directly, with Mercor doing the hiring, management and pay itself.

Data labeling was changing in those years as well. Early on it was mostly simple tagging. As models improved, AI labs wanted working professionals.

Mercor says its talent network now tops 5 million people and that it pays out more than $5M a day.

The business has drawn questions. TechCrunch reported last year that most of Mercor's revenue came from a handful of AI labs. Forbes reported the same year that contractors said a project was cut short and their pay reduced. Mercor disputed the account, and Foody said the role was described as temporary.

Founder Brief by Jarsy

The time has come to wind down radFi.

We still believe in Bitcoin, Runes and Ordinals, but we unfortunately can’t give radFi the attention it needs to thrive for the long term. We’ve put together a plan for a safe & orderly wind down process.

Here’s the plan ↓

Starting today: We are rate limiting all activities that touch liquidity pools for security purposes. LPing and trading are limited to 0.01 BTC per transaction and 0.05 BTC total BTC outflows per day. We will monitor these rate limits and adjust accordingly if needed.

January 11th, 2027: Trading runes and withdrawing LP will be fully deprecated, withdrawing from trading wallets is the only supported activity.

February 11th, 2027: The radFi app will be taken down. You have until then to withdraw from your trading wallet using our app.

After February 11th: Our friends at @ndestrategy will operate a separate website that allows you to withdraw Runes and BTC from your trading wallets without the need for radFi. Trading wallets have always been decentralized, with no dependency on radFi.

Thank you to everyone who traded, LP’d and built with us. Runes Ain’t Dead.

Claude 5.2 发布：性能全面升级，API 价格反而下降 20%

Anthropic 一口气推出 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2，两者底层能力完全相同，区别在于安全护栏：

Fable 面向普通付费用户，Mythos 则向通过审核的网络安全和生命科学机构开放。

实际能力：

编程：FrontierCode 2.0 得分 49.1%，超过 Opus 5.5 的 45.5%、GPT-6 Astra 的 42.8% 和 Gemini 4 Carbon 的 41.1%。

机器人控制：RoboDojo Sim 得分 64.9%，Opus 5.5 只有 39.4%。

数学研究：1000 个 AI Agent 协作，仅用 30 小时，就把费马大定理的既有证明完整形式化为 Lean 代码，供计算机逐步验证。

硬件工程：从文字需求出发，自主完成元器件选型、四层 PCB 布线、3D 外壳和固件设计，三款设备一天内完成可制造设计。

生物研究：Mythos 测试 34 个病毒衣壳结构，28 个预测误差控制在 3 埃以内。

再看成本，这才是最有意思的地方：

API 标准价格从此前的 $10/$50，降至每百万 Token 输入 $8、输出 $40，直接降价 20%。

生成速度最高提升 30%，Fast Mode 最高提速 2.5 倍，但价格翻倍至 $16/$80。

在 FrontierCode 2.0 上，Fable High 档得分 45.3%，几乎追平 Opus 5.5 Max 档的 45.5%，单任务成本却只有后者约一半。

规格方面：100 万 Token 上下文窗口、12.8 万 Token 最大输出，自适应思考始终开启。

普通用户使用方面，Max、Ultra 套餐包含 Fable 使用额度；Pro 用户也获得了 11 月 9 日至 16 日的临时额度优惠，之后恢复额外用量计费。免费用户暂不开放。

Anthropic 给出的使用建议：日常任务用 Opus 5.5，遇到复杂编程、科学研究和需要长时间自主执行的任务，再切换 Fable 5.2。

text:
研究：https://t.co/eJImNGAVxF 95%的收入来自"内盘"，赚的是土狗归零的钱

数据研究机构 Sparsity 发文称，https://t.co/eJImNGAVxF 约95%的协议收入来自内盘阶段，或者市值不到25万美元的代币。

内盘每笔买卖收1.25%的手续费，其中0.95%归平台。按它的统计，四分之三的收入来自上线不到1小时的币。

换句话说，https://t.co/eJImNGAVxF 赚钱靠的是发币数量，而不是能跑出来的金狗。15个市值曾合计达14亿美元的头部 Meme 币，一共只给平台贡献了约150万美元手续费。1000个市值2万美元就归零的币，比一个涨到1亿美元的币还赚钱。

Sparsity 认为，正是这套激励机制催生了批量发币、捆绑抢筹和低市值喊单，也让"拿住"成了亏钱的策略。2024年四季度，https://t.co/eJImNGAVxF 上316万个新币里跑出了207个市值过千万美元的币；今年三季度发了305万个，只跑出24个。
